code: library(bayesAgriFlow)  design <- bayes_rcbd(   data = bayes_teaching_data("rcbd"),   response = "yield",   treatment = "cultivar",   block = "block" )  fit <- bayes_fit(design, engine = "native", draws = 4000, seed = 20260825)  bayes_summary(fit) bayes_contrasts(fit, factor = "cultivar") bayes_rope(fit, range = c(-0.20, 0.20), factor = "cultivar") bayes_pp_check(fit) bayes_report_check(fit) compute <- bayes_compute(   backend = "cmdstanr",   n_cpus = 8,   chains = 4,   parallel_chains = 4 )  fit <- bayes_fit(design, engine = "brms", compute = compute)

title: bayesAgriFlow 1.0.0
text: Consolidates implemented functionality development versions 0.1.0 0.6.0 initial stable 1.x API. Confirms 0.6.0 final pre-1.0 development release; previously reserved 0.7.0 development release used. Freezes design -> prior -> fit -> diagnose -> summarize/evidence -> predict/compare -> decide -> report workflow principal public contract. Carries forward 95 exported functions, 17 registered S3 methods, 30 extensive English vignettes, 31 simulated teaching datasets, 29 double-verified methodological references. Consolidates classical randomized designs, split-plot families, quantitative regression optima, mixed/repeated/GLMM workflows, flexible models, complex experimental systems, model uncertainty, projection predictive selection, Bayesian decision analysis. Adds final 1.0 release documentation, API stability policy, consolidation audit, package citation metadata, 1.0-specific runtime validation harness. claim runtime validation environments R/CmdStan unavailable; frozen 1.0 source candidate must still pass documented R-built tarball release gates.

title: bayesAgriFlow 1.0.0
text: bayes_multivariate() now evaluates residual-correlation family compatibility gate response-versus-family validator. Previously, declaring count family together continuous data made documented “Residual correlation enabled Gaussian/Student” error unreachable; validations remain force order changed. Confirmed maintainer address recorded DESCRIPTION; package URL now includes published documentation site.

what: Model uncertainty, predictive reduction, and Bayesian decisions
title: bayesAgriFlow 0.6.0
text: Added predictive model weights based PSIS-LOO stacking, pseudo-BMA+, pseudo-BMA. Added formal Bayesian model-averaging weights marginal likelihoods prior model probabilities. Added posterior predictive mixtures retain -model uncertainty. Added projection predictive variable selection optional projpred, including cross-validated search, ranking, suggested size, projection, projected prediction. Added transparent utility layer agronomic outcomes, action costs, custom nonlinear utility functions. Added Bayes actions based expected utility, posterior probability optimality, expected regret. Added expected value perfect information (EVPI) generic expected value sample information (EVSI) interface explicit nested-simulation contract. Added direct treatment-decision workflows sensitivity analysis output-value scenarios. Added 3 frozen simulated teaching/validation datasets 4 extensive vignettes devoted model uncertainty, projection predictive selection, decision analysis, value information. Extended reporting validation infrastructure keep posterior-model probabilities, predictive weights, decision utility, regret, information value conceptually distinct.

what: Complex experimental systems and imperfect observations
title: bayesAgriFlow 0.5.0
text: Added spatial field-trial models two-dimensional Gaussian-process terms. Added hierarchical genotype--environment workflows explicit genotype, environment, interaction, environment-specific block roles. Added multivariate Bayesian models response-specific families optional residual correlation supported. Added predictor measurement-error models using current brms mi() formulation rather soft-deprecated () interface. Added one-step joint models continuous predictors missing values, optional response imputation. Added left-, right-, interval-censored continuous-response workflows. Added cumulative, continuation-ratio, stopping-ratio, adjacent-category ordinal models. Added finite mixture models posterior component-membership probabilities. Added distributional regression scale, shape, precision, related distributional parameters. Added 9 frozen simulated teaching/validation datasets 8 extensive vignettes. Extended validation gates spatial recovery, G x E variance components, multivariate residual correlation, missing-data recovery, censoring, ordinal probabilities, mixture membership, distributional parameters.

title: bayesAgriFlow 0.4.0
text: Added nonlinear Bayesian agronomic response templates Michaelis-Menten, Mitscherlich, four-parameter logistic, Gompertz curves brms/Stan. Added Bayesian smoothing splines brms smooth terms explicit basis dimensions optional factor-specific smooths. Added one- multi-predictor Gaussian-process regression exponentiated quadratic, Matern, exponential kernels, including optional Hilbert-space approximations. Added Rubin’s Bayesian bootstrap posterior means medians grouped pairwise contrasts ROPE meaningful-effect probabilities. Added optional PyMC/PyMC-BART backend Bayesian additive regression trees, including response-scale prediction, ArviZ diagnostics, PSIS-LOO, normalized variable-inclusion summaries. Added explicit PyMC environment inspection opt-setup functions; Python remains entirely optional never installed package load. Added four frozen simulated teaching datasets nonlinear, spline, Gaussian- process, BART workflows. Added four extensive English vignettes flexible response models, Bayesian bootstrap inference, PyMC/PyMC-BART workflows. Extended capability registry, posterior prediction, diagnostics, LOO assessment, source validation, forward architecture future spatial, multivariate, measurement-error, censoring, missing-data models.

title: bayesAgriFlow 0.3.0
text: Added general Gaussian Student-t mixed models random intercepts, random slopes, nested grouping chains, crossed grouping factors. Added heterogeneous residual SD structures Gaussian Student-t mixed models. Added repeated-measures designs explicit subject time roles, subject-specific time slopes, optional Gaussian AR(1) residual dependence. Added split-split-plot strip-plot design objects explicit experimental-unit identifiers structural audits. Added GLMM support Bernoulli, binomial, Poisson, negative-binomial, Gamma, lognormal, Beta responses optional brms backend. Added explicit binomial trial counts count exposure offsets. Added bayes_variance_components() bayes_random_effects() hierarchical posterior summaries. Added bayes_predict() unified response-scale posterior mean predictive distributions. Added bayes_loo() bayes_compare_models() PSIS-LOO predictive assessment. Extended frequentist teaching crosswalk mixed selected GLMM structures explicitly warning AR heterogeneous residual structures reproduced. Added seven new frozen simulated teaching datasets mixed, repeated, split-split, strip-plot, count GLMM, binomial GLMM, heterogeneous-residual workflows. Expanded quantitative-regression optimum vignettes. Added four extensive vignettes covering mixed models, repeated measures, split-split/strip-plot designs, non-Gaussian GLMMs. Added double-verified mixed-model GLMM references.

title: bayesAgriFlow 0.2.0
text: Added quantitative-factor regression polynomial regression (degrees 1–3). Added ANCOVA optional treatment--covariate interaction. Added qualitative--quantitative regression. Added posterior biological optimum explicit experimental domain. Added posterior economic optimum fixed output-price linear input-cost assumptions. Added three frozen simulated teaching datasets dose response, ANCOVA, qualitative--quantitative models. Added two extensive vignettes covering quantitative models Bayesian optima. Preserved design-first API CmdStanR parallel-computing layer introduced 0.1.0.

title: bayesAgriFlow 0.1.0
text: Added unified design objects CRD, RCBD, Latin square, factorial, Gaussian split-plot experiments. Added design auditing explicit experimental-unit checks. Added conjugate Gaussian teaching engine fixed-effect designs. Added optional BayesFactor evidence optional brms/Stan estimation. Added cmdstanr computation controls, explicit CPU budgets, parallel chains, optional within-chain threading. Added posterior summaries, treatment contrasts, direction probabilities, ROPE, equivalence, meaningful-effect probabilities. Added prior predictive checks, posterior predictive checks, diagnostic summaries. Added frequentist crosswalk teaching . Added five frozen simulated agronomic teaching datasets. Added eight extensive English vignettes reference-verification assets. Added developer validation scripts local release instructions.
